name: dsh-longtask-relay
description: Long-task relay: keep one task moving across fresh sessions through a workspace truth source (plan + features + evidence + decisions + traps), with automatic handoff that carries the permission preset, goal, and plan mode, a cluster mode that plans first and launches parallel sessions on human confirmation, blocker-aware pausing, and a panel to monitor and steer every chain.

scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/client-boot.mjs && node test/hooks-render.mjs
